panels.description: 展示最近30天内每日的总Token、输入Token和输出Token消耗趋势

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__time(stat_date),
  total_token as "总Token",
  input_token AS "输入Token",
  output_token AS "输出Token"
FROM token_daily_summary
WHERE stat_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
ORDER BY time_sec ASC;

targets.expr:
sum by (cluster_name_clean) (
  label_replace(
    increase(
      envoy_cluster_upstream_rq{
        response_code_class="4xx",
        higress="higress-system-higress-gateway",
        cluster=~".*",
        ai_consumer=~".*",
        ai_model=~".*"
      }[1d]
    ),
    "cluster_name_clean",
    "$1",
    "cluster_name",
    "(?:outbound\\|[0-9]+\\|\\|)?(?:llm-)?(?:deepinfer-|pai-)?([^\\.]+).*"
  )
  unless on(cluster_name_clean) (
    label_replace(vector(0), "cluster_name_clean", "910c-glm51-test", "", "") or
    label_replace(vector(0), "cluster_name_clean", "910cglm-test", "", "") or
    label_replace(vector(0), "cluster_name_clean", "910cglm-test02", "", "") or
    label_replace(vector(0), "cluster_name_clean", "910cglm-test03", "", "") or
    label_replace(vector(0), "cluster_name_clean", "traffic-shadow", "", "") or
    label_replace(vector(0), "cluster_name_clean", "traffic-shadow-test", "", "")
  )
)

targets.expr:
sum by (model_name) (
  rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source_total{source=~"local_cache_hit|external_kv_transfer",app="大模型推理监控"}[5m])
)
/
(clamp_min(sum by (model_name) (
  rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source_total{app="大模型推理监控"}[5m])
),1))

or

sum by (model_name) (
  rate(sglang:cached_tokens_total{app="大模型推理监控"}[5m])
)
/
(clamp_min(sum by (model_name) (
  rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_total{app="大模型推理监控"}[5m])
),1))

avg by (model_name) (vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc{app="大模型推理监控"})
or
avg by (model_name) (sglang:token_usage{app="大模型推理监控"})

avg by (model_name) (sglang:spec_accept_rate{app="大模型推理监控"})
or
sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total{app="大模型推理监控"}[5m]))
  /
(clamp_min(sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total{app="大模型推理监控"}[5m])),1))

sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_sum{app="大模型推理监控"}[5m]))
/
(clamp_min(sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_count{app="大模型推理监控"}[5m])),1))
or
sum by (model_name) (rate(sglang:per_stage_req_latency_seconds_sum{stage="request_process",app="大模型推理监控"}[5m]))
/
(clamp_min(sum by (model_name) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total{app="大模型推理监控"}[5m])),1))

sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_sum{app="大模型推理监控"}[5m])) 
/ 
(clamp_min(sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_count{app="大模型推理监控"}[5m])),1))
or
 sum by (model_name) (increase(sglang:realtime_tokens_total{app="大模型推理监控",mode=~"prefill.*"}[5m])) 
/ 
(clamp_min(sum by (model_name) (increase(sglang:num_requests_total{app="大模型推理监控"}[5m])),1))
